correctness.rationale: Variational substitution u=Hf identifies norm squared with reciprocal first Dirichlet-root/Kirchhoff-junction/Neumann-tip eigenvalue of a compact metric tree. A positive sin stem and cosine leaves eigenfunction and the ground-state identity prove that the unique first pole-free root of cot(ak)=sum_i tan(k b_i) is exactly k=1/||H||; equality forces a one-dimensional eigenspace. Strict convexity of tan(kx) on pre-pole domain and monotonicity of the secular root prove strict terminal-length majorization; collapse to a path gives known supremum. Implicit-function Taylor expansion at equal arms gives strictly positive quadratic coefficient sec²(bk0)tan(bk0)/D. Expansion m tan(kB/m)=Bk+k³B³/(3m²)+O(m^-4) yields endpoint mass law. Independent bisection and perturbation calculations give coefficient 0.0661044248 vs observed 0.0661044439 at perturbation 0.0025; only corroborative.
